measured: M4 Pro 24 GB, 15 November 2026: held-137 (137 lines, 8,149 keys), 24 tokens a key, each model under its own refit gate (docs/rounds/2026-11-15-big.md, docs/rounds/2026-11-15-q35.md); qwen3-4b-mine 16 November 2026 (docs/rounds/2026-11-16-q4b.md)

columns.memory_gb: MLX peak while typing the held set
columns.cap_gb: engine memory guard while this model is loaded
columns.p50_ms / p95_ms: ms to the first whole word at a key
columns.words_shown / words_all: words right from the caret, as Tab Tab Tab: at the keys its gate shows / at every key
columns.kept_per_1k: letters a Tab takes that are his next letters, per 1,000 typed
columns.first_word_pct: the first word is his next word, at every key
columns.layer: his trained layer: true = live's data/adapters; a path = that folder under data/ (data/layers/<name>, outside git); false = none
columns.gate: live = data/gate.json; a file under engine/defaults/ = fitted on this model's trial recording (bench/catalog_gates.py)
